limitations: Seven Object tasks / 14 generated development identities, not LIBERO-Pro full benchmark.
Unsupported candidate identities remain unscored; known 12-pair subsets are not complete 14-identity success rates.
Observed visual/holding/handoff events are not causal ground truth or proof of correct target contact.
Additional branch opportunities, fixed visual skills and observed gains are not learning gains.
No full-system cost efficiency claim while loading, monitoring, preparation or monetary costs remain incomplete.
